name: Special Meeting of the City Council
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this special meeting of the City Council has been called by the Mayor
pursuant to Government Code section 54956. Public comments may be submitted by email at
publiccomments@cityofartesia.us before 12:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting.

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CA 90701
  (562) 865-6262
  YOU MAY VIEW THIS MEETING LIVE OVER THE INTERNET AT
  https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo
  MONDAY, MAY 13, 2024
  5:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS
Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council is asked to fill out a speaker card and submit it to the
City Clerk prior to the commencement of the meeting. Any public comments that cannot be heard
within the next 20 minutes will be heard at the end of the meeting. Under California law, public
comments at special meetings are limited to subjects on the agenda only.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION

The City Council will recess to closed session to discuss the following items:

  1. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – EXISTING LITIGATION
  Pursuant to Government Code section 54956.9
  Number of cases: 1
  Catalyst – Artesia LLC v. City of Artesia
  Los Angeles Superior Court Case No. 23STCP00671

  2. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT
  Pursuant to Government Code section 54957
  Title: Interim City Manager

  3. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Pursuant to Government Code section 54957.6
  Agency designated representative: Mayor
  Unrepresented employee: Interim City Manager

  4. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to Government Code section 54957
  Title: City Attorney

  5. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Pursuant to Government Code section 54957.6
  Agency Designated Representative: Mayor
  Unrepresented Employee: City Attorney
 RECONVENE IN OPEN SESSION

CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

ADJOURNMENT

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special
assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-
6262 at least 72 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are on file in the Office of the
City Clerk and are available for inspection.
minutes_text:
CITY COUNCIL
  ARTESIA  SPECIAL  MEETING  MINUTES
  MONDAY,  MAY 13, 2024 - 5:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, 18747 CLARKDALE  AVENUE,  ARTESIA,  CALIFORNIA

CALL  TO ORDER  SPECIAL  MEETING
Mayor  Lima called  the meeting  to order  at 5:00 p.m.

ROLL  CALL
Present: Mayor Lima, Mayor Pro Tem Taj, Councilmembers  Manalo, Ramoso,  and Trevino
Staff Present: City Manager Schindler, Deputy City Manager Burke,  Finance Manager  Murguia,
City Clerk Alderete,  and City Attorney  Nguyen

ANNOUNCEMENT  REGARDING  PUBLIC  COMMENTS
Public  comments  could  be  provided,  in person  or  submitted  by  email  to
publiccomments(,cityofartesia.us  by 12:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting.  No public  comments
were provided.

CLOSED  SESSION
City Council  recessed  to discuss  the closed  session  items  listed on the agenda  at
5:02 p.m.

The City Council  will recess  to closed  session  to discuss  the following  item:

  1.  CONFERENCE  WITH LEGAL COUNSEL  - EXISTING  LITIGATION
  Pursuant  to Government  Code section 54956.9
  Number of cases: 4
  Catalyst - Artesia LLC v. City of Artesia
  Los Angeles Superior  Court Case No. 23STCPOO671

  2.  PUBLIC  EMPLOYEE  APPOINTMENT
  Pursuant to Government  Code section  54957
  Title: Interim City Manager

  3.  CONFERENCE  WITH LABOR  NEGOTIATORS
  Pursuant  to Government  Code  section  54957.6
  Agency designated  representative:  Mayor
  Unrepresented  employee:  Interim City Manager

  4.  PUBLIC  EMPLOYEE  PERFORMANCE  EVALUATION
  Pursuant  to Government  Code section  54957
  Title: City  Attorney

  5.  CONFERENCE  WITH LABOR  NEGOTIATORS
  Pursuant to Government  Code section 54957.6
  Agency Designated  Representative:  Mayor
  Unrepresented  Employee:  City Attorney

RECONVENE  IN OPEN SESSION
The City Council reconvened in open  session.

CLOSED  SESSION  ANNOUNCEMENT
City Attorney  Nguyen reported that Deputy  City Manager  Burke  would  be appointed  Interim  City
Manager as of June 6, 2024.

ADJOURNMENT
Mayor Lima adjourned  the special  meeting  at 6:48 p.m.

Jennifer  Alderete,  City Clerk
